capabilities: Sync frontmatter-flagged Markdown files to Cloudflare KV on modification
Auto-generate unique document IDs when missing
Organize KV keys with optional collection prefixes
Remove old KV keys when collections change or sync is disabled
Run manual syncs via ribbon icon and commands
extras: Stores a persistent error log file in the vault root; uploads are debounced (default 60 seconds) to limit API calls.
motivation: The README says the plugin is for pulling content into a static site generator such as Eleventy, using Cloudflare KV as a bare bones CMS.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to push selected notes into external storage like Cloudflare KV to serve as a bare-bones CMS for static site generators.

relations.evidence: automatically syncs markdown files to Cloudflare KV storage based on Frontmatter configuration
Perfect for pulling content into a static site generator such as Eleventy

requires.name: Cloudflare API token with Workers KV Storage:Edit permission

summary: Sync plugin that automatically uploads frontmatter-flagged Markdown files to a Cloudflare KV namespace for use as a static-site content source.
